name: Ila Mitra
contribution: Ila Mitra was a communist organiser and peasant leader associated with the Tebhaga movement in Bengal.
context: Her work brought the demands of sharecroppers and rural women into an agrarian struggle shaped by exploitation, state repression, and the upheavals around partition.
impact: She remains a major symbol of peasant resistance and women’s political participation in Bengal’s countryside.
seoDescription: Profile of Ila Mitra, tracing connections to the 1947 Partition, Eastern Bengal, and related political-cultural history.
